**Coaching note:**

When your opponent's king is exposed and pieces are undefended, look for forcing checks that drive the king to a worse square. Here, Qe8+ forces the king to b7, where it can no longer protect the bishop on f8. You win the bishop cleanly. Always scan for forcing moves (checks especially) when material is loose—they often convert advantages into wins.
